user.title: Hybrid Heat
user.description: Choose the house-wide sources. Every one is optional and can be changed later; zones are added afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.outdoor_temp: Recommended. Without it, the outdoor limit for the air conditioners is not applied.
data_description.solar_temp: Temperature of the solar thermal storage tank.
data_description.pv_export: Two separate sensors (both positive) for export and import → fill in both this and “Grid import power”. A single signed net sensor at the grid meter (positive when exporting, negative when importing) → fill in only the first field (this one) and leave “Grid import power” empty. W, kW, … are converted.
data_description.pv_import: Only with two separate sensors → fill in both this and “Grid export power”. With a single signed net sensor, fill in only the first and leave this empty.
data_description.pv_invert: Only for a single signed sensor: enable it if yours is positive when importing from the grid. Ignored when “Grid import power” is set.
data_description.battery_charge: Optional: battery charging counts as photovoltaic surplus, discharging always lowers it. Two separate sensors (both positive) for charging and discharging → fill in both this and “Battery discharging power”. A single signed sensor (positive when charging, negative when discharging) → fill in only the first field (this one) and leave “Battery discharging power” empty.
data_description.battery_discharge: Only with two separate sensors → fill in both this and “Battery charging power”. With a single signed sensor, fill in only the first and leave this empty.
data_description.battery_invert: Only for a single signed sensor: enable it if yours is positive when discharging. Ignored when “Battery discharging power” is set.
data_description.battery_soc: Optional. Battery charge level in %: below the “Minimum battery level” setting, battery charging does not count as surplus (discharging still lowers it).
data_description.boiler: Switch or relay that turns the gas boiler on and off.
data_description.presence: When nobody is home, zones in Auto use the eco temperature.

user.title: Add zone
user.description: A zone is a room or a group of rooms heated together. It needs at least one air conditioner or one thermostatic valve.

data_description.climates: Climate entities of the air conditioners that heat this zone.
data_description.valves: Climate entities of the radiator valves of this zone.
data_description.climate_power: Optional. Without them, a nominal power is counted while an air conditioner is heating.
data_description.temperature_sensors: Optional. Their average is the zone temperature; without them, the air conditioners' temperature is used.
data_description.windows: Optional. An open window sets the zone to antifreeze.
data_description.schedule_source: When the zone is in comfort; outside the schedule it uses the eco temperature.

reconfigure.title: Edit zone
reconfigure.description: Change the entities and the schedule of this zone. It needs at least one air conditioner or one thermostatic valve.

data_description.climates: Climate entities of the air conditioners that heat this zone.
data_description.valves: Climate entities of the radiator valves of this zone.
data_description.climate_power: Optional. Without them, a nominal power is counted while an air conditioner is heating.
data_description.temperature_sensors: Optional. Their average is the zone temperature; without them, the air conditioners' temperature is used.
data_description.windows: Optional. An open window sets the zone to antifreeze.
data_description.schedule_source: When the zone is in comfort; outside the schedule it uses the eco temperature.

schedule_internal.title: Comfort periods
schedule_internal.description: Up to three comfort periods for weekdays (Monday to Friday) and three for the weekend. Fill in both start and end of a period, or leave both empty. A period that ends before it starts continues past midnight; a period whose start equals its end lasts 24 hours.

schedule_external.title: External schedule
schedule_external.description: Choose the entity that drives this zone: while it is on, the zone is in comfort; while it is off, in eco.

data_description.schedule_entity: With a calendar, preheating is not available because the start of the next event is not known in advance.

error.name_required: Enter a name for the zone.

error.band_incomplete: Fill in both start and end of this period, or leave both empty.
